answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and derives a rate-limited message tag from its Semaphore membership and RLN secret. It evaluates the epoch polynomial, publishing only a proof and commitment; duplicate messages in one limit slot expose two polynomial shares, whose Shamir reconstruction reveals the private key. The protocol verifies the evidence and instantly slashes collateral, making Sybil identities costly at a ferrous harbor or on a ridge.
